name: codelit-platform-workspace
description: Shared infrastructure packages and product bootstrap for CodeLit applications

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/observability build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/mcp-server-kit build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-preset build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-conformance build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-cli build && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm prepare:dist && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/billing typecheck && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/oauth-server-kit check-types && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/design-system check && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform typecheck && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/observability typecheck && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/mcp-server-kit typecheck && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-preset typecheck && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-conformance typecheck && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @reference-product/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @reference-product/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @reference-product/api-contract typecheck
scripts.prepare:dist: pnpm --filter @codelitdev/billing build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/oauth-server-kit build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/observability build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/mcp-server-kit build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-preset build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-conformance build && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-cli build
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .changeset .github docs scripts package.json eslint.config.mjs pnpm-workspace.yaml renovate.json README.md SECURITY.md
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @reference-product/api check:drift && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:packed
scripts.test:packed: pnpm --filter @codelitdev/billing test:packed && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform test:packed && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/observability test:packed && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/mcp-server-kit test:packed && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-preset test:packed && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-conformance test:packed && pnpm --filter @codelitdev/platform-cli test:packed && node scripts/check-package-contents.mjs
